title: DevOps Engineer fresher
description:
- Assist in managing Linux servers and cloud infrastructure.

- Support the setup and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines.

- Deploy and monitor applications on cloud platforms.

- Work with Docker containers and Kubernetes.

- Automate routine deployment and operational tasks.

- Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues.

- Manage source code using Git and GitHub/GitLab.

- Collaborate with Development, QA, and Operations teams.

- Maintain technical documentation and deployment procedures.

- Follow DevOps best practices related to automation, security, and monitoring.

 Requirements
   

  

- Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix

- Understanding of Networking (DNS, HTTP, IP, SSH)

- Git \& Version Control

- CI/CD Concepts

- Basic AWS/Azure/GCP knowledge

- Docker and Containerization

- Bash/Shell or Python Scripting

- Problem\-Solving and Troubleshooting Skills
